name: Magic Invitation
introduction:
◆ Event Details ◆
● During the event, Trailblazers can log in to select one of the following 5-star characters:
Jing Yuan, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae, or Acheron.
● Upon claiming a character, you will receive supplies corresponding to each character to immediately raise them to Lv. 60.
● If the selected character's Eidolons are already maxed out, the reward will be converted into Silver Companion Spirit.
